remarks: Discover this desirable corner unit at the prestigious Regents Park, an award-winning community in Westport. Ideally situated near the pool, clubhouse, tennis courts, guest parking, and gatehouse, this 2-bedroom townhouse offers 2.5 baths, a bright kitchen with an island, and a dining room overlooking the garden. (Don't miss the home office alcove and pantry off the kitchen.) The living room boasts a wood-burning fireplace, an adjacent wet bar, and sliders to the generous outdoor space. Enjoy the cheerful ambiance of the living and dining rooms, the centerpiece of this comfortable and luxurious home. A dramatic two-story foyer with a coat closet and adjacent powder room provides a warm welcome. The second-floor Primary Suite boasts a striking vaulted ceiling, a Juliet balcony, a walk-in closet with built-ins, and a spacious private bath. The generous second bedroom is complete with a full bath. Additional features on this level include hall double closets, a linen closet, and a laundry room. The 2 room lower level is complete with carpeting, expansive built-ins, and an ideal home gym or music room space. An attached 2-car garage with a high ceiling and storage completes this exceptional offering. Experience why Regents Park is highly sought after, with its proximity to shopping, dining, train, highways, and town beaches.
